cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a mixed, rotational tape, 50% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.86% · WTI +2.45% · Brent +2.71% · NatGas +1.41%. At the last close, 50% of 68 energy names were green — a mixed, rotational tape. Grid, Storage & Electrification did the heavy lifting at +4.16%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.16%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -1.56%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SMR is the standout at -15.67%
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
